# HDFC Bank Ltd (HDFCBANK) - Investment Note

## RECOMMENDATION SUMMARY

We maintain a **HOLD** rating on HDFC Bank with a target price of ₹1,895, implying 9% upside from current levels of ₹1,738. Limited near-term upside and ongoing post-merger integration challenges keep us on the sidelines despite the bank's franchise strength.

## INVESTMENT CASE

• **Dominant franchise with best-in-class metrics**: HDFC Bank remains India's premier private sector bank with superior asset quality (GNPA <1.3%), consistent ROE above 17%, and strong retail deposit franchise that provides stable, low-cost funding

• **Post-merger scale advantages emerging**: The integration with HDFC Ltd has created India's largest bank by market cap (₹13.2 lakh crore) with enhanced cross-sell opportunities, though execution and system integration remain works in progress through FY25

• **Structural beneficiary of India's credit growth**: Well-positioned to capture share in retail lending (mortgages, auto, personal loans) and SME segments where credit penetration remains low and formalization continues post-GST/digitization reforms

• **Consistent deposit mobilization capability**: Unlike peers struggling with CASA ratio compression, HDFC maintains stronger deposit gathering ability, critical as system liquidity remains tight and credit-deposit ratios elevated

## KEY RISKS

• **Merger integration execution risk**: Near-term margin pressure and operational complexity from combining systems, cultures, and processes could impact performance through FY25; any delays affect earnings trajectory

• **Valuation leaves limited margin of safety**: Trading at premium multiples to private banking peers despite CD ratio concerns and slowing deposit growth post-merger; vulnerable to multiple compression if execution falters

• **Asset quality stress in unsecured book**: Elevated growth in personal loans and credit cards increases vulnerability to potential deterioration if consumption weakens or unemployment rises

## VALUATION

Our ₹1,895 target price is based on 2.8x FY26E adjusted book value, reflecting a modest premium to HDFC's historical 3-year average given near-term integration uncertainties. While the long-term franchise value remains intact, we require greater visibility on margin trajectory and smoother merger execution before turning more constructive. Current risk-reward favors waiting for better entry points.

---
**Rating: HOLD | Target: ₹1,895 | Upside: 9%**
